limits.deadline_semantics: Absolute stable-input deadline passed into request execution; guard and polling clamped to deadline. Request window bounds completion, guard included when time remains.

limitations: Finite software model, no hardware validation or exhaustive proof.
Observation deadline is a supervisor limit, not a chip or Tock deadline.
Fault diagnostics distinguish unexercised sites; completion/retry policy is not prescribed.
Valid cached data and split reads in synchronized forced mode are allowed.
No mandatory ID probe or eager/full calibration acquisition.
Configuration during NVM copy or active config update has model_unsupported effect.
Float and 32-bit pressure alternatives have source-derived numeric envelopes, not physical accuracy bounds.
Not an OS sandbox for hostile candidate code.
Noncompletion beyond specified conversion maximum is an injected device fault; fixed documented waits remain legal and fault outcomes are diagnostic.
